import json, win32com.client

app = win32com.client.GetActiveObject("kwps.Application")
out = []
for doc in app.Documents:
    name = doc.Name
    out.append({
        "name": name,
        "codepoints": [ord(c) for c in name],
        "fully_qualified": bool(doc.Path),
        "saved": bool(doc.Saved),
        "path": doc.Path,
    })
with open(r"C:\Users\admin\AppData\Local\Temp\wps-probe-name\docs.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2)
